Subject: Post-call recap + stakeholder mapping request (Acme Commerce)

Hi Sara, Raj —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and the ask from our side:

- Goal: Validate whether Redwood can be piloted for Acme Commerce’s customer support summarization workflow.
- Success criteria you mentioned: 95% reduction in average handle time for ticket triage, <200ms 95th percentile latency, and SOC 2 evidence for initial review.
- Next steps agreed on call:
  1) Acme to share a high-level stakeholder map (economic buyer, security/legal, procurement, and engineering owners)
  2) Redwood to send a short MLP pilot plan + SOW draft
  3) Intro to procurement/security for questionnaire + timeline

Would you be able to share org-chart/contacts for the above stakeholders? I’ve attached a quick stakeholder template to make it easy — fill in whoever you can and we’ll stitch together an action plan.

Attachments: redwood-stakeholder-template.xlsx

If it helps, I can also propose a 3-week pilot plan once you confirm the stakeholders.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole

marissa@redwoodinference.com
